items.subject: Change in Management
items.details: Universal Cables Limited has informed the Exchange about Completion of tenure of Shri Kishore Kumar Mehrotra as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company with effect from the close of business hours on 10th November, 2026 and Appointment of Shri Sutirtha Bhattacharya as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Independent Director, commencing from 4th November, 2026.
